{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Compute total and converted counts by channel
total_by_channel = df.groupby('channel').size()
converted_by_channel = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].sum()

# Compute conversion rates
total_by_channel = total_by_channel
converted_by_channel = converted_by_channel
conversion_rate_by_channel = converted_by_channel / total_by_channel

# Print the computed values for evidence
print("Total orders by channel:")
print(total_by_channel)
print("\nConverted orders by channel:")
print(converted_by_channel)
print("\nConversion rates by channel:")
print(conversion_rate_by_channel)

# Compute difference in conversion rates (email minus paid_search)
diff_rate = conversion_rate_by_channel['email'] - conversion_rate_by_channel['paid_search']
print("\nDifference in conversion rates (email minus paid_search):")
print(diff_rate)"}
